q.en: The idiom 'to be in hot water' means —
q.as: 'to be in hot water' বাক্যৰীতিটোৰ অৰ্থ —

explanation.en: 'To be in hot water' means to be in trouble or difficulty.
explanation.as: 'To be in hot water' মানে সমস্যা বা অসুবিধাত পৰা।

q.en: The idiom 'to be at sea' means —

explanation.en: 'To be at sea' means to be confused or unsure about what to do.
explanation.as: 'To be at sea' মানে কি কৰিব লাগে সেই বিষয়ে দিশহাৰা বা অনিশ্চিত হোৱা।

q.en: The idiom 'to have a finger in every pie' means —
q.as: 'to have a finger in every pie' বাক্যৰীতিটোৰ অৰ্থ —

options.en: to be involved in many different activities

explanation.en: 'To have a finger in every pie' means to be involved in many different activities or matters.
explanation.as: 'To have a finger in every pie' মানে বিভিন্ন কাম বা বিষয়ত জড়িত থকা।

q.en: The idiom 'to be on cloud nine' means —
q.as: 'to be on cloud nine' বাক্যৰীতিটোৰ অৰ্থ —

explanation.en: 'To be on cloud nine' means to be extremely happy or delighted.
explanation.as: 'To be on cloud nine' মানে অতি আনন্দিত বা উৎফুল্লিত হোৱা।
